text: Damage and push 3 tiles in a line. (Can aim close tile.) Damage: 1. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Damage (3 Reactor Cores): Deals 1 additional damage to all targets; Building Immune (1 Reactor Core): This attack will no longer damage Grid Buildings.

name: Cascading Resonator
text: Killed enemies explode; victims of splash damage also explode on death. Damage: 2 (1 to self). Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Damage (2 Reactor Cores): Increases damage to each hit tile by 1; +Building Immune (1 Reactor Core): This attack will no longer damage Grid Buildings.

name: Rebounding Volley
text: Artillery attack that can bounce to an additional target. (Pull the first and push the second.) Damage: 2. Power: 1 Reactor Core. Upgrades: +1 Damage (2 Reactor Cores): Increases the damage to both targets by 1; Building Immune (1 Reactor Core): This attack will no longer damage Grid Buildings.

name: Repulse
text: Push all adjacent tiles. Power: Free. Upgrades: Shield Self (1 Reactor Core): Creates a personal Shield when used; Shield Friendly (2 Reactor Cores): Shield adjacent ally or Building.

name: Attraction Pulse
text: Fires a projectile, pulling target towards you 1 tile. Power: Free.

name: Shield Projector
text: Shield tiles from damage. 2 uses per battle. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Use (2 Reactor Cores): Increases uses per battle by 1; +3 Area (2 Reactor Cores): Shields 3 additional tiles.

name: Grav Well
text: Artillery weapon that pulls its target towards you. Power: Free.

name: Teleporter
text: Swap places with a nearby tile. (Note: if you are webbed and swap places with another unit, the other unit will become webbed.) Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Range (1 Reactor Core): Extends range of the swap by 1 tile; +2 Range (2 Reactor Cores): Extends range of the swap by 2 tiles.

name: A.C.I.D. Projector
text: Fire a projectile that applies A.C.I.D. and pushes. Power: Free.

name: Confuse Shot
text: Fire a projectile that flips a target's attack direction. Power: Free.

name: Fire Beam
text: Fire a beam that applies Fire in a line. Single-use. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Use (1 Reactor Core): Increases uses per battle by 1.

name: Frost Beam
text: Fire a beam that Freezes everything in a line. Single-use. Power: 1 Reactor Core. Upgrades: +1 Use (2 Reactor Cores): Increases uses per battle by 1.

name: Push Beam
text: Pushes all units in a line. Single-use. Power: Free. Upgrades: Unlimited Use (1 Reactor Core): Removes use restriction in battles.

name: Shield Array
text: Apply a Shield on nearby tiles. Single-use. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Size (1 Reactor Core): Area of effect increased by 2 tiles; +1 Use (1 Reactor Core): Increases uses per battle by 1.

name: Smoke Pellets
text: Surround yourself with Smoke to defend against nearby enemies. Single-use. Power: Free. Upgrades: Ally Immune (1 Reactor Core): No longer applies Smoke on self or allies; +1 Use (1 Reactor Core): Increases uses per battle by 1.

name: Force Swap
text: Force a nearby unit to swap places with any other unit. Damage: 0. Power: 1 Reactor Core. Upgrades: Heal Ally (1 Reactor Core): Swapping an ally will heal it completely; Hurt Enemy (2 Reactor Cores): Swapping an enemy will deal 1 damage to it.

name: Area Shift
text: Push self and all adjacent tiles. Power: Free. Upgrades: Shield Self (1 Reactor Core): Shield the user when activated; Shield Ally (2 Reactor Cores): Shield any Ally units affected by this skill.

name: Control Shot
text: Temporarily control a unit, moving it a short distance (2 tiles). Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Move (1 Reactor Core): Targeted unit can move one extra tile; +1 Move (2 Reactor Cores): Targeted unit can move one extra tile.

name: Firestorm Generator
text: Flaming artillery that drops fire on the way to its target (and push the target). (Starts with 2-tile range.) Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Range (1 Reactor Core): Maximum range is increased by 1; +2 Range (2 Reactor Cores): Maximum range is increased by 2.

name: Seismic Capacitor
text: Damage and flip target. If target is killed, crack adjacent tiles. Damage: 1. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Damage (1 Reactor Core): Increase damage to the target by 1; +1 Damage (3 Reactor Cores): Increase damage to the target by 1.

name: Enrage Shot
text: Force targeted unit to attack adjacent tile. Damage: 1. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Damage (1 Reactor Core): The targeted unit does 1 extra damage with its attack; +1 Damage (1 Reactor Core): The targeted unit does 1 extra damage with its attack.

name: Explosive Warp
text: Teleport to target and push nearby tiles away. Can also be used to push the user to the original position by teleporting to the tile right next to it. Power: Free. Upgrades: +2 Range (1 Reactor Core): Increases the teleport range by 2; +2 Range (1 Reactor Core): Increases the teleport range by 2.

name: Shield Placer
text: Shield target and push adjacent tiles away. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Range (1 Reactor Core): Can target one additional tile away; +1 Range (2 Reactor Cores): Can target one additional tile away. (This is actually +2 range. The text is wrong in game).

name: Boosters
text: Jump forward and push adjacent tiles away. Power: Free.

name: Heat Converter
text: Freeze the tile in front but light the tile behind on Fire in the process. Single-use. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Use (1 Reactor Core): Increases uses per battle by 1.

name: Ice Generator
text: Freeze yourself and nearby tiles. Single-use. Power: 1 Reactor Core. Upgrades: +1 Size (1 Reactor Core): Area of effect increased by 1 tile; +1 Size (2 Reactor Cores): Area of effect increased by 1 tile.

name: Missile Barrage
text: Fires a missile barrage that hits every enemy on the map. Single-use. Damage: 1. Power: 1 Reactor Core. Upgrades: +1 Damage (2 Reactor Cores): Increases damage by 1.

name: Repair Drop
text: Heal all player units (including disabled Mechs). Single-use. Power: Free.

name: Self-Destruct
text: Mech explodes, killing self and anything adjacent to Mech. Single-use. Damage: kills. Power: Free.

name: Smoke Bombs
text: Fly over the targets while dropping Smoke. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Range (1 Reactor Core): Increases potential movement range by 1; +1 Range (1 Reactor Core): Increases potential movement range by 1.

name: Smoke Drop
text: Drops Smoke on 5 tiles anywhere on the map. Single-use. Power: Free.

name: Targeted Strike
text: Call in an air strike on a single tile anywhere on the map. Single-use. Damage: 1. Power: Free.

name: Wind Torrent
text: Push all units in a single direction. Single-use. Power: Free. Upgrades: Unlimited Uses (1 Reactor Core): Removes use restriction in battles.

name: Mass Confusion
text: Cause nearby enemies to flip their attack direction. Single-use. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Size (1 Reactor Core): Area of effect increased by 1 tile; +1 Use (1 Reactor Core): Increases uses per battle by 1.

name: Grid Repulse
text: Overload the grid, causing a building to push away nearby units. Power: Free. Upgrades: Add Shield (1 Reactor Core): The selected building also gains a shield.

name: Grid Assault
text: Overload the grid causing a building to damage and push an adjacent tile. Damage: 1. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Damage (1 Reactor Core): Increases damage by 1; +1 Damage (1 Reactor Core): Increases damage by 1.

name: Bombing Run
text: Call in bombers, dealing damage to every tile in a row or column. Single-use. Damage: 2. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Use (1 Reactor Core): Increases uses per battle by 1; Building Immune (1 Reactor Core): This attack will no longer damage Grid Buildings.

name: Grid Charger
text: Killing an enemy will charge the Power Grid 1 point. Single-use. Damage: 1. Power: 1 Reactor Core.

name: Flood Drill
text: Convert any liquid Tile to a Hole, spreading the liquid to adjacent tiles. Single-use. Power: 1 Reactor Core. Upgrades: +1 Use (1 Reactor Core): Increases uses per battle by 1.

name: Light Tank
text: Deploy a small tank to help in combat. Single-use. The unit it deploys has Health 1, move 3. Power: 2 Reactor Cores. Upgrades: +2 Health (1 Reactor Core): Increases the Tank's max health to 3; +2 Damage (3 Reactor Cores): Increases the Tank's attack damage to 2.

name: Shield-Tank
text: Deploy a Shield-Tank that can give Shields to allies. Single-use. The unit it deploys has Health 1, move 3. Power: 2 Reactor Cores. Upgrades: +2 Health (1 Reactor Core): Increases the Shield-Tank's max health to 3; Projectile (1 Reactor Core): The Shield-Tank instead fires a projectile, allowing you to Shield distant targets.

name: A.C.I.D. Tank
text: Deploy a Tank that can apply A.C.I.D. to targets. Single-use. The unit it deploys has Health 1, move 3. Power: 2 Reactor Cores. Upgrades: +2 Health (1 Reactor Core): Increases the Tank's max health to 3; Push (1 Reactor Core): The tank's attack also pushes its target.

name: Pull-Tank
text: Deploy a Pull-Tank that can pull targets with a projectile. Single-use. The unit it deploys has Health 1, move 3. Power: 2 Reactor Cores. Upgrades: +2 Health (1 Reactor Core): Increases the Pull-Tank's max health to 3; Flying (1 Reactor Core): Gives the Pull-Tank the ability to fly.

name: Ramming Speed
text: Dash across the map, damaging and pushing the target tile. Damage: 1. Power: Free. Upgrades: Smoke Behind (1 Reactor Core): Tile behind you gains Smoke; +2 Damage (3 Reactor Cores): Increases damage by 2.

name: Needle Shot
text: Throw needles at the enemy, pushing the furthest hit tile. (Starts with 1-tile range.) Damage: 1. Power: Free. Upgrades: Range & Damage (2 Reactor Cores): Increases potential hit tiles by 1 and damage on all tiles by 1; Range & Damage (3 Reactor Cores): Increases potential hit tiles by 1 and damage on all tiles by 1.

name: Explosive Goo
text: Artillery attack that damages a tile and pushes adjacent tiles away. Damage: 1. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Tile (1 Reactor Core): Increases area hit by 1 tile; +2 Damage (3 Reactor Cores): Increases damage by 2.

name: Storm Generator
text: All Smoke deals damage to enemy units every turn. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Damage (3 Reactor Cores): Increases Smoke damage by 1.

name: Vek Hormones
text: Enemies do +1 Damage against other enemies. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Damage (1 Reactor Core): Increases damage by 1; +1 Damage (2 Reactor Cores): Increases damage by 1.

name: Flame Shielding
text: All Mechs are immune to Fire. Power: Free.

name: Viscera Nanobots
text: Mechs heal 1 damage when they deal a killing blow. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Heal (2 Reactor Cores): Increase healing to 2.

name: Auto-Shields
text: Buildings gain a Shield after taking damage. Power: Free.

name: Critical Shields
text: If Power Grid is reduced to 1, all buildings gain a Shield. Power: Free.

name: Force Amp
text: All Vek take +1 damage from Bumps and blocking emerging Vek. Power: 1 Reactor Core.

name: Kickoff Boosters
text: Mechs gain +1 move if they start their turn adjacent to each other. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Movement (2 Reactor Cores): Movement bonus is increased by 1.

name: Medical Supplies
text: All Pilots survive death. Power: Free.

name: Networked Armor
text: All Mechs gain +1 HP. Power: 1 Reactor Core. Upgrades: +1 Health (2 Reactor Cores): Increases health bonus to 2.

name: Psionic Receiver
text: Mechs use bonuses from Vek Psion. Power: Free.

name: Repair Field
text: Repairing one Mech will affect all Mechs. (Includes disabled Mechs. Repairing a disabled Mech will save the pilot.). Power: Free.

name: Stabilizers
text: Mechs no longer take damage when blocking emerging Vek. Power: 1 Reactor Core.

name: Nanofilter Mending
text: Standing on Smoke repairs mechs and removes Smoke. Power: Free.

name: Heat Engines
text: Standing on Fire removes Fire and gives the mech "Boost". Power: Free.

name: Networked Shielding
text: Mechs cannot take damage during the Player Turn. Power: 2 Reactor Cores.

name: Void Shocker
text: If a Vek deals no damage to buildings or units when attacking, it takes 1 damage. Power: 2 Reactor Cores.

name: Ralph Karlsson
text: Pilot ability: Experienced: Gain +2 bonus XP per kill.

name: Harold Schmidt
text: Pilot ability: Frenzied Repair: Push adjacent tiles when repairing.

name: Abe Isamu
text: Pilot ability: Armored: Mech gains Armored.

name: Bethany Jones
text: Pilot ability: Starting Shield: Mech starts every mission with a Shield.

name: Henry Kwan
text: Pilot ability: Maneuverable: Mech can move through enemy units.

name: Gana
text: Pilot ability: Preemptive Strike: Deploy anywhere on the map, damaging adjacent enemies. (1 power required)

name: Prospero
text: Pilot ability: Flying: Mech gains Flying (1 power required)

name: Lily Reed
text: Pilot ability: Impulsive: Gain +3 Move on first turn of every mission.

name: Chen Rong
text: Pilot ability: Sidestep: After attacking, gain 1 free tile movement.

name: Camila Vera
text: Pilot ability: Evasion: Mech unaffected by Webbing and Smoke.

name: Isaac Jones
text: Pilot ability: Temporal Reset: Gain 1 extra 'Reset Turn' every battle.

name: Silica
text: Pilot ability: Double Shot: Mech can act twice if it does not move. (2 power required)

name: Archimedes
text: Pilot ability: Fire-and-Forget: Move again after shooting. (1 power required)

name: Kai Miller
text: Pilot ability: Arrogant Boost: Mech is Boosted if full health, otherwise -1 Move.

name: Rosie Rivets
text: Pilot ability: Reassuring Hand: After Move, Repair adjacent Mechs.

name: Morgan Lejeune
text: Pilot ability: Field Research: Mech gains Boosted on kill.

name: Adam
text: Pilot ability: Chosen One: On Reset Turn, gain Shield and +2 Move.

name: Kazaaakpleth
text: Pilot ability: Mantis: 2 damage melee attack replaces Repair.

name: Mafan
text: Pilot ability: Zoltan: +1 Reactor Core. Reduce Mech HP to 1. Gain Shield every turn.

name: Ariadne
text: Pilot ability: Rockman: +3 Health and immune to Fire.

source_type: intothebreach.fandom.com Weapons (unit a weapon deploys, token) table, 30 Oct 2026 (supplement)
